covered_report_window: Friday, August 7, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Monday, August 10, 2026 before the U.S. market open (America/New_York). No qualifying liquid Friday AMC name survived timing confirmation.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities rallied and Treasury yields fell after July payrolls unexpectedly declined by 23,000, supporting rate-relief sentiment while also raising growth concerns.

methodology.disparity_formula: 0-100 composite of dispersion in the three direction scores and reversal-risk estimates; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: No new framework change. Existing mandatory expectation-bar, key-metric-first, forward-look override, timing hygiene, and separate reversal-risk rules were applied.
